tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

If omitted, uses the agent definition's model, else the default (inherits from the parent unless a default subagent model is configured). When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final message is returned to you as the tool result; it is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- A previously spawned agent cannot be continued from here; every Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""randjoin.py seed n: builds a random wall layout with the original and compares every wall's
face and end points between the two programs."""
import subprocess, json, os, sys, random, tempfile, shutil
seed = int(sys.argv[1]); n = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4
random.seed(seed)
types = ['Generic - 200mm', 'Exterior - 300mm', 'Interior - 100mm']
locs = ['centre', 'exterior-finish', 'interior-finish', 'core-centre', 'exterior-core', 'interior-core']
cmds = []
def pt():
    return [random.randint(-8, 8) * 500, random.randint(-8, 8) * 500]
for k in range(n):
    kind = random.random()
    t = random.choice(types)
    extra = ''
    if random.random() < 0.3:
        extra += ',"location":"%s"' % random.choice(locs)
    if kind < 0.5:
        # a polyline, closed or not
        m = random.randint(2, 4)
        pts = [pt() for _ in range(m)]
        closed = 'true' if (m >= 3 and random.random() < 0.5) else 'false'
        cmds.append('wall {"points":%s,"closed":%s,"type":"%s"%s}' % (json.dumps(pts), closed, t, extra))
    else:
        arc = (",\"arc\":%d" % random.choice([-120,-60,-30,30,60,90,150])) if random.random() < 0.5 else ""
        cmds.append("wall {\"points\":%s,\"type\":\"%s\"%s%s}" % (json.dumps([pt(), pt()]), t, extra, arc))
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/views-dims')
args = ['/workspace/executable', 'run']
for c in cmds:
    args += ['--cmd', c]
args += ['--cmd', 'grid {"start":[-100000,-50000],"end":[100000,-50000]}', '--cmd', 'grid {"start":[-50000,-100000],"end":[-50000,100000]}', '--save', 'r.bimcraft']
p = subprocess.run(args, cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, 'r.bimcraft')):
    print('build failed', p.stderr.strip()[:200]); sys.exit(0)
pr = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, 'r.bimcraft')))
proj = '/tmp/views-dims/rand%d.bimcraft' % seed
shutil.copy(os.path.join(d, 'r.bimcraft'), proj)
shutil.rmtree(d)
walls = [k for k, e in pr['elements'].items() if e['category'] == 'wall']
grids = [k for k, e in pr['elements'].items() if e['category'] == 'grid']
refs = []
for w in walls:
    for face in ['centre', 'left', 'right', 'start', 'end']:
        for point in ['start', 'end']:
            refs.append('{"id":%s,"face":"%s","point":"%s"}' % (w, face, point))
out = subprocess.run(['python3', '/tmp/views-dims/ptcmp.py', proj, grids[0], grids[1]] + refs, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
print('seed', seed, out.strip().split('\n')[-1])
if 'same' in out and out.strip().split('\n')[-1].split('/')[0] != out.strip().split('\n')[-1].split('/')[1].split(' ')[0]:
    print('\n'.join(cmds))
    print(out)

import math, itertools
def unit_r(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1]); k = 1.0/l
    return (v[0]*k, v[1]*k)
def unit_d(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1])
    return (v[0]/l, v[1]/l)
def sub(a,b): return (a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1])
def add(a,b): return (a[0]+b[0], a[1]+b[1])
def mul(a,k): return (a[0]*k, a[1]*k)
def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
def cross(a,b): return a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]
def left(d): return (-d[1], d[0])

CASES = {
    # name: (A start, A end (node), B start (node), B end, tA, tB, expected: True = mitre kept)
    '109': ((3000.0,-2000.0),(2500.0,1500.0),(2500.0,1500.0),(-1000.0,-2000.0),200.0,200.0, True),
    '127': ((-500.0,-500.0),(3000.0,-1000.0),(3000.0,-1000.0),(2000.0,-2000.0),100.0,100.0, False),
}

def variants(a0, a1, b0, b1, ta, tb, unit):
    p = a1
    dA = unit(sub(a1, a0)); dB = unit(sub(b1, b0))
    uA = mul(dA, -1.0); uB = dB
    th = max(ta, tb)
    res = {}
    # cos/sin based
    c = dot(uA, uB); s = abs(cross(uA, uB))
    res['c'] = c; res['s'] = s
    # along = (t/2) * (1 + c) / s  (equal thickness)
    res['along_cs'] = (ta / 2) * (1 + c) / s
    # half angle via atan2
    ang = math.atan2(cross(uA, uB), dot(uA, uB))
    res['ang'] = abs(ang)
    res['along_tan'] = (ta / 2) / math.tan(abs(ang) / 2)
    # bisector
    bis = unit(add(uA, uB))
    sh = abs(cross(bis, uA))  # sin(half)
    res['along_bis'] = (ta / 2) * dot(bis, uA) / sh
    # line meets through the node: A's face at offA through p + nA*offA, B's face p + nB*offB
    for offA, offB in [(ta/2, tb/2), (-ta/2, -tb/2), (ta/2, -tb/2), (-ta/2, tb/2)]:
        pA = add(p, mul(left(dA), offA)); pB = add(p, mul(left(dB), offB))
        den = cross(dA, dB)
        t = cross(sub(pB, pA), dB) / den
        x = add(pA, mul(dA, t))
        res['node_t%+d%+d' % (offA, offB)] = t
        res['node_al%+d%+d' % (offA, offB)] = dot(sub(x, p), uA)
        res['node_dist%+d%+d' % (offA, offB)] = math.sqrt(dot(sub(x, p), sub(x, p)))
        # start-based lines
        pA2 = add(a0, mul(left(dA), offA)); pB2 = add(b0, mul(left(dB), offB))
        t2 = cross(sub(pB2, pA2), dB) / den
        x2 = add(pA2, mul(dA, t2))
        res['st_al%+d%+d' % (offA, offB)] = dot(sub(x2, p), uA)
        res['st_dist%+d%+d' % (offA, offB)] = math.sqrt(dot(sub(x2, p), sub(x2, p)))
    return res

for unit in (unit_r, unit_d):
    for name, (a0, a1, b0, b1, ta, tb, exp) in CASES.items():
        r = variants(a0, a1, b0, b1, ta, tb, unit)
        print(name, unit.__name__, 'expect', 'kept' if exp else 'squared')
        for k, v in r.items():
            print('   ', k, repr(v))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""bound.py n seed: builds two walls meeting exactly at the sharpness limit (equal thickness),
asks the original whether each corner of A's end is mitred, and prints the candidate formulas."""
import subprocess, json, os, sys, tempfile, shutil, math, random
orig = '/workspace/executable'
n = int(sys.argv[1]); random.seed(int(sys.argv[2]))
TY = {100.0: 'Interior - 100mm', 200.0: 'Generic - 200mm', 300.0: 'Generic - 300mm'}

def unit(v):
    l = math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1]); k = 1.0/l
    return (v[0]*k, v[1]*k)
def sub(a,b): return (a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1])
def add(a,b): return (a[0]+b[0], a[1]+b[1])
def mul(a,k): return (a[0]*k, a[1]*k)
def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
def cross(a,b): return a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]
def left(d): return (-d[1], d[0])

def query(d, refs):
    out = []
    for r in refs:
        xy = []
        for g in ('100005', '100004'):
            p = subprocess.run([orig, 'run', 'p.bimcraft', '--cmd', 'dimension {"refs":[{"id":%s},%s],"at":[-60000,-60000]}' % (g, r)], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
            xy.append(json.loads(p.stdout.strip().split('\n')[-1])['values'][0] - 50000)
        out.append(xy)
    return out

def one():
    while True:
        v = (random.randint(-9, 9), random.randint(-9, 9))
        if v != (0, 0):
            break
    sgn = random.choice([1, -1])
    w = (3*v[0] - 4*sgn*v[1], 4*sgn*v[0] + 3*v[1])
    k = random.randint(1, 4) * 100
    m = random.randint(1, 4) * 100
    k = max(1, int(3000 / math.hypot(*v)))
    m = max(1, int(3000 / math.hypot(*w)))
    p = (random.randint(-8, 8) * 500.0, random.randint(-8, 8) * 500.0)
    t = random.choice([100.0, 200.0, 300.0])
    a0 = (p[0] + k*v[0], p[1] + k*v[1]); b1 = (p[0] + m*w[0], p[1] + m*w[1])
    return a0, p, b1, t

def cands(a0, p, b1, t):
    dA = unit(sub(p, a0)); dB = unit(sub(b1, p))
    uA = mul(dA, -1.0); uB = dB
    h = t / 2
    c = dot(uA, uB); s = abs(cross(uA, uB))
    r = {}
    r['cs'] = h * (1 + c) / s <= t
    ang = math.atan2(cross(uA, uB), dot(uA, uB))
    r['tan'] = h / math.tan(abs(ang) / 2) <= t
    bis = unit(add(uA, uB))
    r['bis'] = h * dot(bis, uA) / abs(cross(bis, uA)) <= t
    # per corner, A's left face (offset +h) with B's left (+h), A's right with B's right

computes (a locked linear dimension's saved length)."""
import subprocess, json, os, sys, tempfile, shutil

exe = sys.argv[8] if len(sys.argv) > 8 else '/workspace/executable'
a0, p, b1, t = (a[0], a[1]), (a[2], a[3]), (a[4], a[5]), a[6]
TY = {100.0: 'Interior - 100mm', 200.0: 'Generic - 200mm', 300.0: 'Exterior - 300mm'}
tb = float(os.environ.get('TB', t))
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/views-dims')
cmds = ['wall {"points":[[%r,%r],[%r,%r]],"type":"%s"}' % (a0[0], a0[1], p[0], p[1], TY[t]),
        'wall {"points":[[%r,%r],[%r,%r]],"type":"%s"}' % (p[0], p[1], b1[0], b1[1], TY[tb])]
args = ['/workspace/executable', 'run']
for c in cmds:
    args += ['--cmd', c]
subprocess.run(args + ['--save', 'p.bimcraft'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
node = '{"id":100002,"face":"centre","point":"end"}'
for r in ['{"id":100002,"face":"left","point":"end"}', '{"id":100002,"face":"right","point":"end"}',
          '{"id":100003,"face":"left","point":"start"}', '{"id":100003,"face":"right","point":"start"}']:
    out = []
    for o in ('x', 'y'):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""limit4.py: which way of computing a mitre corner gives the original's exact values."""
import math, itertools

def sub(a,b): return (a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1])
def add(a,b): return (a[0]+b[0], a[1]+b[1])
def mul(a,k): return (a[0]*k, a[1]*k)
def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
def cross(a,b): return a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]
def left(d): return (-d[1], d[0])
def ln(v): return math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1])

def units(v):
    l = ln(v); h = math.hypot(v[0], v[1])
    a = math.atan2(v[1], v[0])
    return {'rec': (v[0]*(1.0/l), v[1]*(1.0/l)), 'div': (v[0]/l, v[1]/l), 'hdiv': (v[0]/h, v[1]/h), 'ang': (math.cos(a), math.sin(a))}

def meets(P, D, Q, E):
    den = cross(D, E)
    s = cross(sub(Q, P), E) / den
    yield 'pd', add(P, mul(D, s))
    t = cross(sub(Q, P), D) / den
    yield 'qe', add(Q, mul(E, t))
    x1, y1 = P; x2, y2 = add(P, D); x3, y3 = Q; x4, y4 = add(Q, E)
    dd = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
    a = x1 * y2 - y1 * x2; b = x3 * y4 - y3 * x4
    yield 'det', ((a * (x3 - x4) - (x1 - x2) * b) / dd, (a * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * b) / dd)
    # line equations a x + b y = c
    a1, b1 = -D[1], D[0]; c1 = a1 * P[0] + b1 * P[1]
    a2, b2 = -E[1], E[0]; c2 = a2 * Q[0] + b2 * Q[1]
    dt = a1 * b2 - a2 * b1
    yield 'eq', ((c1 * b2 - c2 * b1) / dt, (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) / dt)

def two_point_lines(P0, P1, Q0, Q1):
    """Lines through two points each."""
    D = sub(P1, P0); E = sub(Q1, Q0)
    for nm, x in meets(P0, D, Q0, E):
        yield 'tp0' + nm, x
    for nm, x in meets(P1, D, Q1, E):
        yield 'tp1' + nm, x
    for nm, x in meets(P0, D, Q1, E):
        yield 'tp01' + nm, x
    for nm, x in meets(P1, D, Q0, E):
        yield 'tp10' + nm, x
    # segments' determinant with the four points
    x1, y1 = P0; x2, y2 = P1; x3, y3 = Q0; x4, y4 = Q1
    dd = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
    a = x1 * y2 - y1 * x2; b = x3 * y4 - y3 * x4
    yield 'det4', ((a * (x3 - x4) - (x1 - x2) * b) / dd, (a * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * b) / dd)
    # parametric with t from P0
    den = cross(D, E)
    t = cross(sub(Q0, P0), E) / den
    yield 'par', (P0[0] + t * D[0], P0[1] + t * D[1])
    u = cross(sub(Q0, P0), D) / den
    yield 'paru', (Q0[0] + u * E[0], Q0[1] + u * E[1])

def corners(a0, p, b1, offA, offB):
    vA = sub(p, a0); vB = sub(b1, p)
    for un in ('rec', 'div', 'hdiv', 'ang'):
        dA = units(vA)[un]; dB = units(vB)[un]
        nA = left(dA); nB = left(dB)
        PA0 = add(a0, mul(nA, offA)); PA1 = add(p, mul(nA, offA))
        PB0 = add(p, mul(nB, offB)); PB1 = add(b1, mul(nB, offB))
        for nm, x in two_point_lines(PA0, PA1, PB0, PB1):
            yield un + '/' + nm, x
        for bn, (P, Q) in {'A0B0': (PA0, PB0), 'A1B0': (PA1, PB0), 'A0B1': (PA0, PB1), 'A1B1': (PA1, PB1)}.items():
            for dn, (D, E) in {'unit': (dA, dB), 'full': (vA, vB)}.items():
                for mn, x in meets(P, D, Q, E):
                    yield '%s/%s/%s/%s' % (un, bn, dn, mn), x
        # trig: along from the angle
        uA = mul(dA, -1.0)
        c = dot(uA, dB); s = cross(uA, dB)
        ang = math.atan2(s, c)
        for an, al in {'cs': (offB + offA * c) / s if s else 0}.items():
            yield un + '/trig' + an, add(add(p, mul(nA, offA)), mul(uA, al))

def check(name, a0, p, b1, off, want):
    print(name, want)
    hits = []
    for nm, x in corners(a0, p, b1, off, off):
        d = (abs(x[0] - p[0]), abs(x[1] - p[1]))
        if d == want:
            hits.append(nm)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""limit4.py: which way of computing a mitre corner gives the original's exact values."""
import math, itertools

def sub(a,b): return (a[0]-b[0], a[1]-b[1])
def add(a,b): return (a[0]+b[0], a[1]+b[1])
def mul(a,k): return (a[0]*k, a[1]*k)
def dot(a,b): return a[0]*b[0]+a[1]*b[1]
def cross(a,b): return a[0]*b[1]-a[1]*b[0]
def left(d): return (-d[1], d[0])
def ln(v): return math.sqrt(v[0]*v[0]+v[1]*v[1])

def units(v):
    l = ln(v); h = math.hypot(v[0], v[1])
    a = math.atan2(v[1], v[0])
    return {'rec': (v[0]*(1.0/l), v[1]*(1.0/l)), 'div': (v[0]/l, v[1]/l), 'hdiv': (v[0]/h, v[1]/h), 'ang': (math.cos(a), math.sin(a))}

def meets(P, D, Q, E):
    den = cross(D, E)
    s = cross(sub(Q, P), E) / den
    yield 'pd', add(P, mul(D, s))
    t = cross(sub(Q, P), D) / den
    yield 'qe', add(Q, mul(E, t))
    x1, y1 = P; x2, y2 = add(P, D); x3, y3 = Q; x4, y4 = add(Q, E)
    dd = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
    a = x1 * y2 - y1 * x2; b = x3 * y4 - y3 * x4
    yield 'det', ((a * (x3 - x4) - (x1 - x2) * b) / dd, (a * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * b) / dd)
    # line equations a x + b y = c
    a1, b1 = -D[1], D[0]; c1 = a1 * P[0] + b1 * P[1]
    a2, b2 = -E[1], E[0]; c2 = a2 * Q[0] + b2 * Q[1]
    dt = a1 * b2 - a2 * b1
    yield 'eq', ((c1 * b2 - c2 * b1) / dt, (a1 * c2 - a2 * c1) / dt)

def two_point_lines(P0, P1, Q0, Q1):
    """Lines through two points each."""
    D = sub(P1, P0); E = sub(Q1, Q0)
    for nm, x in meets(P0, D, Q0, E):
        yield 'tp0' + nm, x
    for nm, x in meets(P1, D, Q1, E):
        yield 'tp1' + nm, x
    for nm, x in meets(P0, D, Q1, E):
        yield 'tp01' + nm, x
    for nm, x in meets(P1, D, Q0, E):
        yield 'tp10' + nm, x
    # segments' determinant with the four points
    x1, y1 = P0; x2, y2 = P1; x3, y3 = Q0; x4, y4 = Q1
    dd = (x1 - x2) * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * (x3 - x4)
    a = x1 * y2 - y1 * x2; b = x3 * y4 - y3 * x4
    yield 'det4', ((a * (x3 - x4) - (x1 - x2) * b) / dd, (a * (y3 - y4) - (y1 - y2) * b) / dd)
    # parametric with t from P0
    den = cross(D, E)
    t = cross(sub(Q0, P0), E) / den
    yield 'par', (P0[0] + t * D[0], P0[1] + t * D[1])
    u = cross(sub(Q0, P0), D) / den
    yield 'paru', (Q0[0] + u * E[0], Q0[1] + u * E[1])

def corners(a0, p, b1, offA, offB):
    vA = sub(p, a0); vB = sub(b1, p)
    for un in ('rec', 'div', 'hdiv', 'ang'):
        dA = units(vA)[un]; dB = units(vB)[un]
        nA = left(dA); nB = left(dB)
        PA0 = add(a0, mul(nA, offA)); PA1 = add(p, mul(nA, offA))
        PB0 = add(p, mul(nB, offB)); PB1 = add(b1, mul(nB, offB))
        for nm, x in two_point_lines(PA0, PA1, PB0, PB1):
            yield un + '/' + nm, x
        for bn, (P, Q) in {'A0B0': (PA0, PB0), 'A1B0': (PA1, PB0), 'A0B1': (PA0, PB1), 'A1B1': (PA1, PB1)}.items():
            for dn, (D, E) in {'unit': (dA, dB), 'full': (vA, vB)}.items():
                for mn, x in meets(P, D, Q, E):
                    yield '%s/%s/%s/%s' % (un, bn, dn, mn), x
        # trig: along from the angle
        uA = mul(dA, -1.0)
        c = dot(uA, dB); s = cross(uA, dB)
        ang = math.atan2(s, c)
        for an, al in {'cs': (offB + offA * c) / s if s else 0}.items():

        if d == want:

    print('  exact:', hits)
    return set(hits)

h2 = check('109 A right', (3000.0, -2000.0), (2500.0, 1500.0), (-1000.0, -2000.0), -100.0, (70.71067811866669, 212.1320343558982))

"""collect.py seed n out.json: random grids, random aligned dimensions between their lines and end
points, each one's unrounded value from the original (a lock's saved length)."""
import subprocess, json, os, sys, tempfile, shutil, random
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
seed, n, out = int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]), sys.argv[3]
exe = os.environ.get('EXE', '/workspace/executable')
random.seed(seed)
def r(): return round(random.uniform(-5000, 5000), 1)
grids = []
# a few families of parallel grids
for fam in range(3):
    dx, dy = r(), r()
    for k in range(3):
        x0, y0 = r(), r()
        grids.append(((x0, y0), (round(x0 + dx, 1), round(y0 + dy, 1))))
d = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/views-dims')
args = ['/workspace/executable', 'run']
for a, b in grids:
    args += ['--cmd', 'grid {"start":[%r,%r],"end":[%r,%r]}' % (a[0], a[1], b[0], b[1])]
subprocess.run(args + ['--save', 'p.bimcraft'], cwd=d, capture_output=True, text=True)
pr = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, 'p.bimcraft')))
ids = sorted(int(k) for k, e in pr['elements'].items() if e['category'] == 'grid')
G = {}
for k in ids:
    e = pr['elements'][str(k)]
    G[k] = (tuple(e['start']), tuple(e['end']))
nid = pr['next_id']
cmds = []
for i in range(n):
    kind = random.choice(['pp', 'lp', 'll', 'lpp'])
    at = [r() * 10, r() * 10]
    if kind == 'pp':
        refs = [{"id": random.choice(ids), "point": random.choice(['start', 'end'])} for _ in range(2)]
    else:
        fam = random.randrange(3)
        fl = ids[fam * 3:fam * 3 + 3]
        refs = [{"id": random.choice(fl)}]
        if kind == 'll':
            refs.append({"id": random.choice([x for x in fl if x != refs[0]['id']])})
        else:
            refs.append({"id": random.choice(ids), "point": random.choice(['start', 'end'])})
        if kind == 'lpp':
            refs.append({"id": random.choice(ids), "point": random.choice(['start', 'end'])})
    cmds.append({"refs": refs, "at": at})
def one(c):
    dd = tempfile.mkdtemp(dir='/tmp/views-dims')
    shutil.copy(os.path.join(d, 'p.bimcraft'), dd)
    m = len(c['refs']) - 1
    q = subprocess.run([exe, 'run', 'p.bimcraft', '--cmd', 'dimension ' + json.dumps(c), '--cmd', 'dimension_constraint {"id":%d,"locked":%s}' % (nid, json.dumps(list(range(m)))), '--save', 'q.bimcraft'], cwd=dd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        e = json.load(open(os.path.join(dd, 'q.bimcraft')))['elements'][str(nid)]
        res = [repr(x['length']) for x in e['locked']]
    except Exception:
        res = None
    shutil.rmtree(dd)
    return res
with ThreadPoolExecutor(8) as ex:
    vals = list(ex.map(one, cmds))
shutil.rmtree(d)
json.dump({'grids': {str(k): v for k, v in G.items()}, 'dims': [dict(c, values=v) for c, v in zip(cmds, vals) if v]}, open(out, 'w'))
print(len([v for v in vals if v]), 'of', n)
